description: Once-a-day gate for the report-only Test read map and Proof reuse daily, which also wake after each push CI run on main because scheduled runs start hours late: a dispatch always runs; a schedule or workflow_run wake runs only when the day's artifact (test-read-map-day-<date>, proof-reuse-daily-<date>) does not exist yet and, with --not-before-hour, only from that UTC hour. Reads the Actions artifacts API and writes run and reason to GITHUB_OUTPUT.
